claim_es: Vegan diet, malabsorption and certain medications increase B12 inadequacy risk; fatigue alone does not diagnose deficiency.
applicability: Dietary adequacy and deficiency assessment, not nonspecific energy enhancement
mandatory_precautions: Metformin and acid-suppressing medicines may reduce B12 status
Neurologic symptoms or anemia warrant clinical evaluation
Check fortified foods and other B12 supplements before adding products
proposed_rule_decision: Consider nutritional assessment; no universal dose or energy claim
notes: Source-linked critical appraisal intake; individual primary papers and jurisdictional guidelines require further verification.
